theme: Three ways for objects to talk: closure callbacks, the delegate pattern and the observer pattern

terms.definition: A closure you pass in so another piece of code can call it when work is done.

terms.definition: A pattern where an object hands some of its work to another object through a protocol.

terms.definition: A pattern where many objects get told when one object changes.

Learn to explain how objects tell each other news: Closure Callback, Delegate Pattern & Observer Pattern, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Closure Callback - A closure you pass in so another piece of code can call it when work is done.
Delegate Pattern - A pattern where an object hands some of its work to another object through a protocol.
Observer Pattern - A pattern where many objects get told when one object changes.

Explain Closure Callback, Delegate Pattern & Observer Pattern in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Closure Callback, Delegate Pattern, Observer Pattern 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Closure Callback - A closure you pass in so another piece of code can call it when work is done.
한국어: Closure Callback: 작업이 끝났을 때 다른 코드가 호출하도록 넘겨 주는 클로저

Delegate Pattern - A pattern where an object hands some of its work to another object through a protocol.
한국어: Delegate Pattern: 객체가 프로토콜을 통해 일부 작업을 다른 객체에 맡기는 패턴

Observer Pattern - A pattern where many objects get told when one object changes.
한국어: Observer Pattern: 한 객체가 바뀌면 여러 객체가 알림을 받는 패턴

landscape.hook: Can you explain Closure Callback, Delegate Pattern and Observer Pattern in English?

dialogue.title: Telling the screen
dialogue.setting: Choosing how a loader reports back

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the loader must tell the screen when the data is ready. How?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The simplest way is a closure callback. You pass a closure, and the loader calls it when done.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And UIKit uses delegates for that, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. In the delegate pattern, an object hands some work to another object through a protocol.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The loader calls `didLoad`, and `Screen` decides what to do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if three screens need the same news?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then use the observer pattern. Many observers get told when one object changes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the delegate pattern talks to one object, but the observer pattern talks to many?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Delegates are one to one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And a closure callback is the lightest of the three.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, use a closure callback for a single, quick result.
